title: Unit tests for DDL generation and export
description: Write automated unit tests to verify DDL generation produces correct SQL and no-drops safety validation works.
acceptanceCriteria: Unit tests verify CREATE TABLE generation
Unit tests verify key and constraint generation
Unit tests verify no DROP statements in generated DDL
Unit tests verify user confirmation flow
resultEvidence: Frontend unit tests (node:20-alpine container, docker-test-runner skill): docker run --rm --init --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --pids-limit 512 --memory 2g --shm-size 1g --user 1000:1000 --tmpfs /tmp -e HOME=/tmp -e npm_config_cache=/tmp/.npm -v /home/rpozo/workspace/automatic-solution-generator/build/database-diagram-webapp:/work:rw -w /work node:20-alpine sh -c "npm ci --ignore-scripts && npx vitest run" → 22 test files, 217 tests, 217 passed, 0 failed.

Backend unit tests (node:20-alpine container, docker-test-runner skill): docker run --rm --init --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --pids-limit 512 --memory 2g --shm-size 1g --user 1000:1000 --tmpfs /tmp -e HOME=/tmp -e npm_config_cache=/tmp/.npm -v /home/rpozo/workspace/automatic-solution-generator/build/database-diagram-webapp:/work:rw -w /work/backend node:20-alpine sh -c "npm ci --ignore-scripts && npx vitest run" → 12 test files, 177 tests passed, 0 failed (17 integration tests skipped — require live PostgreSQL, not related to ticket acceptance criteria).

Acceptance Criterion 1 — CREATE TABLE generation: Covered by frontend src/ddl/ddlGenerator.test.ts ('produces CREATE TABLE statements for all tables') and backend backend/src/services/ddl-generator.test.ts ('produces CREATE TABLE statements for every table').

Acceptance Criterion 2 — Key and constraint generation: Covered by frontend ddlGenerator.test.ts ('includes inline PRIMARY KEY for single-column keys', 'produces FOREIGN KEY constraint from relationships') and backend ddl-generator.test.ts (inline PK, composite PK, FOREIGN KEY, UNIQUE constraints, CREATE INDEX).

Acceptance Criterion 3 — No DROP statements in generated DDL: Covered by frontend ddlGenerator.test.ts ('contains no DROP, TRUNCATE or DELETE statements'), backend ddl-generator.test.ts ('produces no DROP/TRUNCATE/DELETE statements'), backend ddl-safety.test.ts and ddl-safety-validator.test.ts (extensive DROP/TRUNCATE/DELETE rejection tests).

Acceptance Criterion 4 — User confirmation flow: Covered by frontend src/components/DdlPreview.test.tsx ('disables Execute DDL until confirmation checkbox is checked', 'does not call applyDDL without confirmation', 'calls applyDDL with confirm=true when user confirms', Cancel handler, null-connection guard).
Acceptance Criterion 5 — All tests pass: Verified — frontend 217/217 passed, backend 177/177 passed, 0 failures.
No source code or test files were modified; all tests were pre-existing and passing.
All tests executed inside Docker containers; nothing ran on the host. No --privileged, --network host, or Docker socket mounts used.
